name: LAYERED Inc.
summary: LAYERED Inc. provides medical digital transformation (DX) services. The company offers products, such as Kakarite, a patient management and communication support system; and Medical Window, medical information media; and services, including website production and operation support for medical institutions. The company serves clinics, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, and local governments. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.
